result.title: The Price of Not Planning: Parallel Sampling Depth Peaks at the Reconstruction Threshold
result.summary: Masked diffusion models sample the tokens of one round independently. Planned decoders first generate a coarse plan, then fill in the tokens in parallel. We ask when a plan saves rounds, how many it saves, and how fine it must be. We study this on broadcast trees: the leaves are the tokens, the internal nodes are the plan, and the edge correlation $θ$ sets how strongly tokens depend on the plan. Errors are measured by the forward Kullback-Leibler divergence $\varepsilon$, and the lower bounds hold for every deterministic value-adaptive rule, also with learned conditionals. We show that a decoder without the plan needs of order $\min\{n,(n/\varepsilon)^α\}$ rounds below the reconstruction threshold, where $α=\log b/(4\log(1/θ))$ rises to $1/2$ at the threshold, and that the exponent stays below $1/2$ above it (binary channel: $0.02\leθ\le0.98$). With the plan, $\log_b n+1$ rounds suffice. In the binary model below the threshold, a plan with units of $m$ tokens needs of order $\log_b(n/m)+\min\{m,(n/\varepsilon)^α\}$ rounds, so it gives logarithmic depth exactly when $m$ is logarithmic. A plan therefore helps most near the threshold, and only if its units are small. Exact divergence computations in the Gaussian model with up to $2^{20}$ leaves confirm these exponents below the threshold.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究带「计划」的并行解码何时能减少采样轮数：在广播树上把内部节点视为计划、叶子视为 token，用前向 KL 度量误差，给出无计划与有计划解码器所需轮数的下界，并分析计划单元大小 m 与能否达到对数深度的关系。
AI.relevance_reason: 其对计划粒度与并行采样深度、重建阈值附近收益的刻画，可能为 LVR 中 latent 计划的粒度选择与并行生成轮数/计算分配提供分析视角，可供核查这些结论能否迁出合成树模型。
